page.overview:
Who is Cosimo?

Cosimo was the Prince of Miragliano at the turn of the 20th and 21st centuries IC who agreed on the new plan for the city's reformed layout with Leonardo da Miragliano. After Leonardo's great engineering success remade Miragliano, Prince Cosimo hired him as the city-state's court inventor.

These events followed Governor Maximo's failure to contain a plague of Giant Rats in a downtown district of the city.

Prince Cosimo and his great investment in his birth city could be a reference to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cosimo_de%27_Medici Cosimo de' Medici], an Italian banker and politician who established the Medici family as effective rulers of Florence during much of the Italian Renaissance.
